scope: Within each axis,source credit is the intervention. Keep source,pair,trace,hidden pool and D policy fixed. Acquire occurs at P dispatch. Release occurs at first client output,not final decode completion. Arrival-to-acquire is source admission wait. It does not identify GPU idle or a full critical-path cause. Host prepare-to-ready can include packing and other requests between chunks. Mean stage deltas do not decompose TTFT p95. Natural EOS outputs can differ. No independent-start CI or cross-axis hardware-invariant causal claim. Credit1 is not the serving default.
